transcript: For me to tell 16-year-olds to be celibate is one thing. A 37-year-old who's used to getting some, I need a different kind of gospel. Many modern-day preachers do not teach what accords with sound doctrine, as the Bible says. They'll bring in new things to make them and their church enticing to the world. They'll try to dress a certain way or dance a certain way, behave a certain way, because they want to be friends with the world. The Bible says, though, being friends with the world means that you are enemies with God. And they will have a large audience, because the Bible says that many people will not hear the sound doctrine, but they'll have itching ears, and these people know how to tickle their ears. Be careful that you are not one of these people that are listening to people who do not have doctrine that lines up with Scripture. Be careful your pastor doesn't know how to expound on the text. Be careful that you are not attending a church where you are preached to by a modern preacher.
